name: Stability Ball Close-Grip Push-Up
steps: Place your hands close together on top of the ball and walk your feet back into a plank.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes tightly to keep the ball steady beneath you.
Bend your elbows straight back alongside your torso to lower your chest slowly toward the stability ball.
Press powerfully through both hands to straighten your arms back to the starting plank.
tips: Widen your feet slightly to improve side-to-side balance on the unstable ball.
Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears and avoid sagging your hips.
